responsibility: This header implements GCC’s generic summary-container templates that attach per-symbol or per-callgraph-edge analysis data to the symtab and keep it synchronized with node and edge lifecycle events. It defines function_summary, fast_function_summary, call_summary, and fast_call_summary families on top of hook-registered base classes, handling insertion, removal, duplication, allocation in heap or GGC memory, and traversal of stored summaries. Its role is reusable IPA infrastructure for passes that maintain per-function, per-variable, or per-call summaries across cloning and deletion in the symbol table.
